[P2] Exclude occupied peer processes from Python recovery

With Python and `replace-worker`, recovery can use the still-occupied peer's worker/process and name the victim in `replacesWorkerId`, yet pass validation. This uniqueness check excludes recovery, allowing overlapping requests on the same Python process to establish supposedly recovered capacity. Require recovery's process to differ from every held peer, while permitting victim-process reuse under `reuse-worker`, and add a regression test.
